title: AI Call Agent Solutions - Automated Phone Calling

facts.fact: The vendor states that firms using its outbound agents for collections see 60% more efficient collections.
The vendor states its agents handle 5,000,000 hours of conversations every month.
The vendor offers a choice of more than 10,000 expressive voices, and customers can also clone their own voice.
facts.quote: Choose from 10,000+ expressive voices (or clone yours) to match the accents and tones your customers trust most.

facts.fact: The vendor states its voice agents support customers in more than 90 languages.
facts.quote: Support customers in 90+ languages with consistent tone and clarity.
